content:
The IdentityAccountInfo  table in the advanced hunting schema contains information about
account information from various sources, including Microsoft Entra ID. This table also includes
information and link to the identity that owns the account. Use this reference to construct
queries that return information from this table.
For information on other tables in the advanced hunting schema, see the advanced hunting
reference.
